# graphiant_extranet (Resource)

A local (intra-tenant) data exchange policy, sharing routes between segments/sites. host_prefix_set / source.prefix_set / branches.prefix_set (enterprise prefix set references) are not yet exposed. Exactly one of auto / manual should be set (not enforced by a validator).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graphiant_extranet" "shared_services" {
  name        = "shared-services"
  description = "Share the shared-services segment with branch sites"

  shared_segment  = 100
  target_segments = [200, 201]

  auto = {
    auto_propagate = true
  }

  branches = {
    sites = [graphiant_site.example.id]
  }
}
```

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import graphiant_extranet.shared_services <extranet_id>
```
